This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in bringing innovative products from development into manufacturing, working in a highly multidisciplinary environment that combines mechanics, electronics, software, materials, and manufacturing technologies . What You'll Do Lead New Product Introduction (NPI) activities from design readiness through production ramp-up. Collaborate closely with global R&D teams to ensure Design for Manufacturing (DFM/DFX) and successful system integration. Own Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), First Article Inspection (FAI) activities, and support Product Lifecycle Management (PLCM) milestones. Serve as the primary technical interface between Operations and multidisciplinary R&D teams. Support production, field issues, customer escalations, and continuous product improvements. Develop engineering processes, standardize workflows, and mentor team members to ensure high execution quality and operational excellence. What You'll Bring B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. 10 +years of engineering experience within a industrial, medical device, semiconductor, or complex multidisciplinary environment. At least 5 years of experience in NPI and manufacturing. 3+ years of technical leadership or people management experience. Experience working in a highly multidisciplinary environment, collaborating with Mechanical, Electrical, Software, Systems, Manufacturing, and Operations teams. Hands-on experience in mechanical design using SolidWorks. Experience creating and managing BOMs and engineering documentation. Experience working with PLM systems. Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, DFM/DFX, product lifecycle management, and supplier management. Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
